# Props glossary

Every prop declared by the library's exported components, what it does, its type, and where the same name is used
with a different type or meaning. Variances last reviewed 2026-10-19.

## Scope and method

- **Source:** the TypeScript compiler, run over `src/index.ts` and every specialist entry point (`src/*/index.ts`).
  Every exported `*Props` type was read, plus exported components whose props are declared inline.
- **Own props only.** Props inherited from `react-aria-components`, `react-aria`, `react-stately`,
  `@react-types/shared` or React's DOM attributes are not listed one by one. The
  [component index](#component-index) says which components inherit from them.
- **Types** are shown as written in the source, so named aliases such as `Tone` or `Size` are kept. A `|` in a
  type is escaped as `\|`. Long types are cut at 100 characters; follow the component index to the source.
- **Descriptions** come from the JSDoc. Where a prop has none, or is shared by several components, a description was
  written from the source.
- **Variance** was judged by reading each shared prop's types, JSDoc and usage:
  - **meaning:** the same name does materially different things, or uses different units, on some components.
    AGENTS.md asks for a pre-existing prop name never to be reused for a different purpose, so these are the ones to
    look at.
  - **type:** the same purpose, but the TypeScript type differs between components.
  - blank: one type and one meaning everywhere.
- **Regenerate** with `make props-glossary`. Shared names added since the last review are marked _Unreviewed_; add
  them to `scripts/props-glossary.json`.

## Variances

### Meaning variances

The same name, used for a different purpose or in different units. Candidates for renaming.

| Prop | Uses | How it varies |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| [`actions`](#prop-actions) | 9 | `ReactNode` control slot on Banner, Card, CollapsibleCard, TabList, CopyField, Header. RuleBuilder, RuleList use `readonly RuleAction[]`: data definitions of the actions a rule can run, not rendered controls. |
| [`columns`](#prop-columns) | 12 | Layout count (`Columns or GridColumns`, or `1 or 2 or 3`) on Grid, MultiView, DescriptionList; slides per view on Carousel (Grid's type). Data column definitions on DataTable, TableToolbar, EditableTable, Spreadsheet. Axis items on HeatmapChart. Column timestamps on Flowsheet. |
| [`details`](#prop-details) | 2 | ErrorState: `ReactNode` technical details content. Flag: `readonly FlagDetail[]` selecting which facts (name, nativeName, code, languages) to show beside the flag. |
| [`direction`](#prop-direction) | 2 | Timer: `'down' or 'up'` counting direction (default down). Stack: `'column' or 'row'` layout axis (default column). |
| [`display`](#prop-display) | 2 | DurationField: `'compound' or 'single'` formatting of the committed value as one or several units. MathFormula: `'inline' or 'block'` layout placement in text vs centred block. |
| [`format`](#prop-format) | 4 | Timer: `'clock' or 'words'` display style. ModelViewer: source file format. Barcode: barcode symbology. RichTextEditor: document storage format (Markdown, HTML, Lexical JSON). |
| [`height`](#prop-height) | 37 | CSS `string` on most (charts, viewers, Canvas, Map, Terminal). `number` px on Sparkline. `number or string` on Skeleton, Barcode. CanvasItem: `number` in canvas world units. |
| [`id`](#prop-id) | 6 | Logical key: Tab and TabPanel (`Key`, pairs a tab with its panel and drives `selectedKey`), CanvasItem (`string`, the item's key in the canvas selection). DOM element id: Knob and Rating (the input's id) and MathFormula (the root's id, for in-page links). |
| [`isClearable`](#prop-isclearable) | 3 | A clear button shows while there is a value on Select and the other fields (Select's onChange may then receive null). Rating has no button: choosing the current value again, or Delete or Backspace, clears it. |
| [`label`](#prop-label) | 76 | `ReactNode` on fields, MenuButton, StatTile etc.; `string` on Spinner, Stepper, meters, tickers, CopyButton. Divergent: MathFormula uses it for an equation number like (3); CandlestickChart names the price series, not the chart; TableToolbar gives the row noun for the summary; CopyButton names what is copied (Copy label). |
| [`levels`](#prop-levels) | 3 | LogViewer: `readonly LogLevel[]`, controlled filter of visible log levels. AudioMeter: `readonly number[]`, measured dBFS per channel (data). HierarchyPicker: `readonly HierarchyLevel[]`, names of hierarchy columns. |
| [`links`](#prop-links) | 2 | SankeyChart: `readonly SankeyLink[]`, flow edges between nodes. Footer: `readonly FooterLink[]`, navigation hyperlinks. |
| [`messages`](#prop-messages) | 4 | UIProvider: `Partial<Messages>`, overrides for library UI strings. MessageList: `readonly ChatMessage[]`, the chat messages, oldest first. |
| [`mode`](#prop-mode) | 11 | Pagination family: static `cursor`/`offset` union discriminator. OutcomeChart: render style `lines`/`stacked`. MathInput: entry restriction level. ConfigForm, CardForm, PageForm: `FormMode` controlled view/edit state with `defaultMode`, i.e. user-changeable state rather than config. |
| [`name`](#prop-name) | 15 | Form submission name: JsonEditor, TemplateEditor, unit fields, MoneyField, Knob, Rating, RichTextEditor. Displayed entity name: FileThumbnail (file name), Avatar (person name, initials, colour), Brand (product name), UserMenu (signed-in user). |
| [`playhead`](#prop-playhead) | 2 | MusicNotation takes `{ measure, beat } or null` (both 1-based); PianoRoll takes a `number` of beats from the start. |
| [`renderValue`](#prop-rendervalue) | 3 | TilePicker uses it to display the chosen option `(option) => ReactNode`. ScheduleEditor and TierEditor use it (custom value mode) to render the editable input field for a row value `(props: RowValueFieldProps<V>) => ReactNode`; it is `never` in numeric mode. |
| [`scale`](#prop-scale) | 6 | `'linear' or 'log'` mapping on Knob, LatencyChart; `HeatScale` colour scale on HeatmapChart, CalendarHeatmap. AudioMeter.scale is a measurement unit (`'dbfs' or 'lufs'`); PianoRoll.scale is a musical scale (`MusicScale` root and mode) for row highlighting. |
| [`segments`](#prop-segments) | 2 | SegmentedMeter uses `MeterSegment[]` as stacked value parts of a bar; CoordinatePlane uses `PlaneSegment[]` as geometric line segments (from/to points, optional arrowhead). |
| [`series`](#prop-series) | 10 | Chart series types vary: `TimeSeries[]`, `LatencySeries[]`, `CategorySeries[]`, `ScatterSeries[]`, `BoxPlotSeries[]`, `HourlySeries or ScheduleSeries[]`; LiveTimeSeries omits `data`. DicomViewer.series is DICOM image series (stacks of images shown as switchable thumbnails), not plotted data. |
| [`shortcut`](#prop-shortcut) | 3 | MenuItem: a literal display hint ("⌘E"), not bound. CommandPalette: a `mod+k`-style key spec that registers a global listener (`null` disables). CommandPaletteTrigger: the same spec rendered as Kbd keys. Format and behaviour differ. |
| [`side`](#prop-side) | 2 | Drawer uses `'start' or 'end'` for screen edge; TradeTicket uses `TradeSide` for the trade direction (buy or sell), controlled. |
| [`size`](#prop-size) | 76 | Token unions vary (ButtonSize, Size, DialogSize, BadgeSize, CalendarSize, AvatarSize, `'sm' or 'md'`, `'sm' or 'md' or 'lg'`). QRCode takes a `number` of CSS pixels (default 192). Dialog sizes cap width; SegmentedMeter is bar thickness; ProbabilityBar `sm` changes layout. |
| [`type`](#prop-type) | 11 | Rendering kind on Sparkline, CategoryBarChart, CategoryChart, CategoryWaterfall, CategoryFunnel, CategoryRadar; HTML input type on TextField. FileThumbnail.type is the file's MIME type (data); StreamPreview and VideoPlayer type is the stream protocol (`auto`, HLS, DASH, progressive). |
| [`width`](#prop-width) | 3 | Skeleton takes a CSS length or px `number or string`. CanvasItem takes a `number` in canvas world units (defaults to the child's size). Page takes a max-width preset `'narrow' or 'medium' or 'full'` capping content width. |

| [`selectionMode`](#prop-selectionmode) | 9 | `'single' or 'multiple'` on Calendar, Canvas; literal `'multiple'` on MultipleCalendar and `'single'` on SingleCalendar; adds `'none'` on TileGrid, MediaLibrary, DataTable, ListView. Defaults differ: single on Calendar, multiple on Canvas, none on MediaLibrary, DataTable, ListView. |
| [`shape`](#prop-shape) | 2 | `'text' or 'rect' or 'circle'` (placeholder shape, default `text`) on Skeleton; `AvatarShape` (`'circle' or 'square'`, default `circle`) on Avatar. |
| [`source`](#prop-source) | 3 | `string` (text the slug derives from) on SlugField; `MediaStream or AudioNode` on AudioMeter; `string or ArrayBuffer or Blob` (document URL or data) on PdfViewer. |
| [`status`](#prop-status) | 7 | `RolloutStatus` (drives rollout state) on RolloutProgress; `{ tone, label }` override on Gauge, MeterBar; `StreamStatus` on StreamPreview, StreamStatusChip; `ReactNode` slot beside the title on Page, PageHeader. |
| [`thresholds`](#prop-thresholds) | 6 | `TimerThresholds` on Timer; `UptimeThresholds` (default warn below 99.9, danger below 99) on UptimeBar; `readonly ChartThreshold[]` on TimeSeriesChart, LiveTimeSeries; `GaugeThresholds` on Gauge, MeterBar. |
| [`ticks`](#prop-ticks) | 3 | `readonly SliderTick[]` (with optional labels) on Slider, RangeSlider; `readonly number[]` on Knob. |
| [`title`](#prop-title) | 53 | `ReactNode` on most (Dialog, Drawer, Card, EmptyState, Page, CodeBlock, forms...); `string` on charts, DepthChart, ModelViewer, NodeGraph, CoordinatePlane, PdfViewer, StreamPreview, VideoPlayer, Terminal (often an accessible name only). |
| [`tone`](#prop-tone) | 24 | `Tone` on most; `ButtonTone` on Button; `'neutral' or 'danger'` on MenuItem, ConfirmDialog; `FeedbackTone` (default `info`) on Banner; `ProgressTone` (default `accent`) on ProgressBar; `TextTone` on Heading; Sparkline defaults to `accent`; Rating and RatingDisplay to `warning`; on ToggleButton it colours only the pressed state. |
| [`tools`](#prop-tools) | 2 | `readonly DicomTool[]` on DicomViewer; `readonly AnnotationKind[]` on ImageAnnotator. |
| [`types`](#prop-types) | 3 | _Unreviewed._ `readonly AnyWidgetType[]` on WidgetPicker; `readonly MediaAssetType[]` on AssetPicker, MediaLibrary. |
| [`unit`](#prop-unit) | 23 | `string` on most; `ReactNode` on StatTile; `'ms' or 's' or 'µs'` (default `ms`, the unit the data is in) on LatencyChart; `ModelUnits` (`'mm' or 'cm' or 'm' or 'in'`, the physical length one model unit represents) on ModelViewer; `never` on ScheduleEditor, TierEditor in custom value mode. |
| [`updatedAt`](#prop-updatedat) | 3 | `Date \| number \| string` (Date, epoch ms or ISO string) on PriceTicker, StatusBar; `Date` on WidgetFrame. |
| [`validate`](#prop-validate) | 7 | `(value: number or null)` on NumberField; `(pair, all)` per row on KeyValueEditor; async `(slug, signal) => Promise` on SlugField; `(rows) => errors by row and column` on EditableTable, Spreadsheet. |
| [`value`](#prop-value) | 74 | Each control uses its own value type (number, string, ids, dates, ranges, rules, files...). Display-only on StatTile, PriceTicker, Gauge, cells, ReferenceValue; content to copy or encode on CopyButton, CopyField, Barcode, QRCode. Radio.value is the option's own value, not the current selection. |
| [`valueAxis`](#prop-valueaxis) | 5 | `ValueAxisOptions` on CategoryBarChart, CategoryWaterfall, BoxPlotChart; CategoryChart accepts a union; CategoryRadar uses it for the radial axis (title only read in summary, defaults to zero start). |
| [`values`](#prop-values) | 6 | `PropertyValues` (selected objects) on PropertyInspector; `FilterValues` (controlled, with onChange) on FilterPanel; [row][column] matrix on HeatmapChart; ISO-date record on CalendarHeatmap; `ObservationValue[]` on Flowsheet, ObservationTrend. |
| [`variant`](#prop-variant) | 20 | Each component has its own union: ButtonVariant (default `solid`), IconButtonVariant (`ghost`), BadgeVariant (`soft`), TextVariant, StepperVariant, MenuButton, SplitButton fill styles, ToggleButtonVariant (`soft`, `outline`, `ghost`); layout variants on Timer, PriceTicker, Gauge, AudioPlayer. |
| [`view`](#prop-view) | 6 | `'month' or 'week'` (default month) on Calendar, MultipleCalendar, SingleCalendar; `'grid' or 'list'` (controlled) on AssetPicker, MediaLibrary. |
| [`warnings`](#prop-warnings) | 2 | `readonly ReactNode[]` on PlanReview; `readonly string[]` on TradeTicket. |
| [`widgetState`](#prop-widgetstate) | 2 | _Unreviewed._ `Readonly<Record<string, JsonObject>>` on Dashboard; `JsonObject \\| undefined` on WidgetRender. |
| [`widgetTypes`](#prop-widgettypes) | 2 | _Unreviewed._ `WidgetRegistry \\| readonly AnyWidgetType[]` on Dashboard; `WidgetRegistry` on WidgetConfigureDialog. |
| [`zoom`](#prop-zoom) | 3 | `PdfZoom` (`'fit-width' or 'fit-page'` or number), controlled, on PdfViewer; `number` scale factor (default 1) on MusicNotation. |

### Near-duplicate names

Different names for the same purpose. Not a conflict, but worth unifying.

| Name | On | Same as | On | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Glossary

Alphabetical. **Req.** is whether the prop is required: yes, no, or mixed across components. Where a name has more
than one type, the 6 most common are listed with the number of components using each.

[A](#a) · [B](#b) · [C](#c) · [D](#d) · [E](#e) · [F](#f) · [G](#g) · [H](#h) · [I](#i) · [J](#j) · [K](#k) · [L](#l) · [M](#m) · [N](#n) · [O](#o) · [P](#p) · [Q](#q) · [R](#r) · [S](#s) · [T](#t) · [U](#u) · [V](#v) · [W](#w) · [X](#x) · [Y](#y) · [Z](#z)

### A

| <a id="prop-aria-hidden"></a>`aria-hidden` | `boolean` | no | Hides the sparkline from assistive technology (for example when it only decorates a stat). |  | Sparkline |
| <a id="prop-aria-label"></a>`aria-label` | `string` | mixed | Accessible name for the component (or its trigger/landmark) when there is no visible label; many default to a localized message. |  | ActionBar, AssetPicker, Barcode, BottomTabBar, Canvas, Carousel, CidrList, CodeBlock, +89 more |
| <a id="prop-aria-labelledby"></a>`aria-labelledby` | `string` | no | Id(s) of the element(s) that label the component. |  | Canvas, Carousel, CursorPagination, Cycler, DashboardGrid, DataTable, DicomViewer, EditableTable, +23 more |
